step1_analysis.circuit_type: Equivalent circuit of a CMOS Transmit-Receive (T/R) Switch
step1_analysis.description: This circuit models the passive parasitics and matching network of a T/R switch in receive mode. The Tx path is isolated via the OFF-state capacitances of the Tx MOSFET, while the Rx path is connected via an LC pi-network.

paper_reference.title: Integrated CMOS Transmit–Receive Switch Using LC-Tuned Substrate Bias for 2.4-GHz and 5.2-GHz Applications

Rx_Insertion_Loss.description: Signal loss from the antenna port to the receive port in Rx mode.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated as S21 in a 50-ohm system using the passive equivalent circuit.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Passive matching network losses are similar across technologies, dominated by inductor Q-factor.

Tx_Isolation.description: Signal leakage from the antenna port to the transmit port in Rx mode.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated as S31 in a 50-ohm system using the passive equivalent circuit.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the OFF-state capacitance of the Tx switch, which scales with transistor size.

P1dB_Rx.description: Input 1-dB compression point in receive mode.

sky130_expected.calculation: Requires nonlinear transistor models (not present in this passive netlist).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Linearity depends on the substrate bias and device breakdown, which is comparable between 0.18um and SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure insertion loss and isolation of the T/R switch equivalent circuit at 2.4 GHz and 5.2 GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* T/R Switch Equivalent Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT (with assumed component values for simulation)
L2 BPF_Ant LNA_Rx 2n
C2a BPF_Ant GND 200f
C2b LNA_Rx GND 200f
CsbM1 BPF_Ant N0 300f
CdbM1 PA_Tx N0 300f
Rtx1 N0 GND 50
RsubM1 N0 GND 500

V_gnd GND 0 0

* Port Terminations and Source
R_ant BPF_Ant_src BPF_Ant 50
V_ant BPF_Ant_src 0 dc 0 ac 2
R_rx LNA_Rx 0 50
R_tx PA_Tx 0 50

.control
ac dec 100 1G 10G
let rx_il_db = vdb(LNA_Rx)
let tx_iso_db = vdb(PA_Tx)

meas ac rx_il_24 find rx_il_db at=2.4G
meas ac tx_iso_24 find tx_iso_db at=2.4G
meas ac rx_il_52 find rx_il_db at=5.2G
meas ac tx_iso_52 find tx_iso_db at=5.2G

print rx_il_24 tx_iso_24 rx_il_52 tx_iso_52
quit
.endc
